name: zam-core
description: The Symbiotic Learning Kernel: Elevating Human Intelligence through AI Collaboration.

scripts.build: tsup && npm run build:panel && npm run build:copilot-extension && npm run build:vscode-extension
scripts.build:copilot-extension: tsup --config tsup.config.copilot-extension.ts && vite build --config vite.config.copilot-extension.mts && node scripts/prepare-copilot-extension.mjs
scripts.build:vscode-extension: tsup --config tsup.config.vscode-extension.ts && vite build --config vite.config.vscode-extension.mts && node scripts/prepare-vscode-extension.mjs
scripts.build:panel: vite build --config vite.config.panel.mts && vite build --config vite.config.panel.mts --mode recall && vite build --config vite.config.panel.mts --mode graph && vite build --config vite.config.panel.mts --mode settings && vite build --config vite.config.panel.mts --mode okf
scripts.pg:test: POSTGRES_URL=$(node scripts/pg-dev.mjs url) vitest run tests/kernel/postgres-rls.test.ts tests/kernel/provider-contract.test.ts tests/kernel/postgres-provider.test.ts

author: ZAM Contributors
